page.title: Sucker for Love: Crush Landing overview

facts.label: Genre
facts.value: Horror-comedy visual novel with romance and colorful puzzles.

facts.label: Premise
facts.value: A sentient shapeshifting comet named Hheily crash-lands in an apartment and pulls the player into an interplanetary conflict between light and dark.

facts.label: Goal
facts.value: Feed Hheily's flame to help save the world and possibly win a kiss.

facts.label: Scope
facts.value: This guide separates official full-game facts from demo observations and community questions.

evidence.finding: Official Steam description and feature list, checked 2026-09-01.
Official announcement trailer used to cross-check the premise and tone.

facts.label: Hheily
facts.value: Hheily is a captivating sentient comet that can shapeshift into different forms, including a human-like form.

facts.label: Arrival
facts.value: The comet crashes into the player's apartment, making the apartment the central story space.

facts.label: Conflict
facts.value: The story frames Hheily inside an interplanetary conflict between light and dark and ties her survival to feeding her flame.

evidence.finding: Official Steam description, checked 2026-09-01.
Official trailer cross-check for Hheily and the apartment setting.

facts.label: Confirmed central character
facts.value: Hheily is the sentient shapeshifting comet and the central character named in the official premise.

facts.label: Roster boundary
facts.value: The official store page does not publish a complete character roster; this page does not invent one from genre expectations or prior series entries.

facts.label: Public achievement evidence
facts.value: The public achievement record names Flora, Mina, the divorced couple, Scam Likely, Midori, Maria, Monami, and the Sentient Darkness in achievement text; these names are evidence of referenced interactions, not a complete narrative roster or route guide.

evidence.finding: Official Steam premise names Hheily.
Public achievement descriptions contain the listed interaction names; checked 2026-09-01.
Community hub contains a current Who is the main character? thread, showing the roster/protagonist question is real and unresolved by the store description.
